Sweep h/J from 0.10 to 2.50 in steps of 0.05 (33 parameter points). At each h, prepare the ground state on 9 qubits and measure: (1) transverse magnetization m_x = (1/9) sum_i <sigma^x_i>, (2) longitudinal susceptibility chi_z = 9*(<m_z^2> - <|m_z|>^2), (3) Binder cumulant U4 = 1 - <m_z^4>/(3<m_z^2>^2), and (4) nearest-neighbor correlation C_1 = (1/9) sum_i <sigma^z_i sigma^z_{i+1}>. Run the full sweep under five noise conditions: p_err in {0.0, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05}, where p_err is the single-qubit depolarizing error rate per gate layer (two-qubit rate = p_err, single-qubit rate = p_err/2) and readout error epsilon = 0.01. For each noise level, identify the pseudo-critical field h_c from the susceptibility peak. Implement zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE): evaluate each observable at p_err, 2*p_err, and 3*p_err noise levels and Richardson-extrapolate to the zero-noise limit.
